final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT eventannotm AS t, AVG(instownpct) AS a FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY eventannotm), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(instownpct) AS b FROM sentimentandfundamentals), s3 AS (SELECT s1.t AS t, s1.a AS a, s1.a - s2.b AS d FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.b IS NOT NULL WHERE s1.a > s2.b) SELECT AVG(a), AVG(d) FROM s3
